title: Canonical scalar comparison on degree-zero coefficient sheaves
statement: For commutative rings $A,A′$ in the coefficient universe, a ring map $\phi:A\to A′$, and a scheme $T$, use the published ordinary scalar adjunction $S\dashv R$ and derived scalar adjunction $Q\dashv V$ of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility] and [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $i_A,i_{A′}$ for placement in degree zero. Exact restriction has its canonical comparison $c:i_{A′}V\cong Ri_A$. Define $q_M:Q(i_A M)\to i_{A′}(SM)$ as the adjunction transpose of $i_A(\eta_M)\gg c^{-1}_{SM}$. At the coefficient-unit object use the published normalized scalar unit identification $Q(\mathbf1)\cong\mathbf1$ of [lem-pur-exceptional-coefficient-comparison], transported along the canonical single/unit identifications to $Q(i_A\mathbf1)\to i_{A′}\mathbf1$. All tensor structures are the published ones used in [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization]. Retain the normalized scalar/pullback and tensor comparisons of [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection] and [lem-pur-exceptional-coefficient-comparison]; these are transparent aliases, not new scalar functors or comparisons.
